data.gender_notes: Mahtalat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'htl', meaning 'to exalt' or 'to be noble'. In Islamic tradition, the name Mahtalat symbolizes the exalted status of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the importance of striving for spiritual growth. The name Mahtalat carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahtalat usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name serves as a reminder of the importance of introspection, self-improvement, and the pursuit of a noble and virtuous life.
